mira (partnerships): Nimbus wants marketplace listing this week. Legal flagged SCIM mapping, KMS custody model, and HSM attestation as blockers. Can security/eng list must-haves? cc @ben

ben (security): Must-haves: short KMS custody doc (BYOK vs Redwood-managed) + sample IAM policy, SCIM attribute map + sample payload, HSM attestation (module cert and firmware sig). I can draft the custody/liability blurb.

alex (eng): From infra: need connector type (PKCS11 or REST), supported algs (RSA-PSS, ECDSA), and expected signing latency for remote sign. If BYOK remote sign, we'll run latency tests on staging.

jordan (platform): We'll provide a 14-day staging tenant and scoped API key but require a terraform PR to limit scope to provisioning.write.

onboard-bot: Attached -> https://redwood.internal/partners/checklists/nimbus-gate (access: partnerships,security,legal) :white_check_mark:

mira (partnerships): Nimbus to provide staging admin and attestation PDF by tomorrow or we delay. Sync 9am tomorrow if open. :alarm_clock:
